cluster.headline: סקר מדאיג בתאילנד: 77% בעד להחמיר את האכיפה נגד ישראלים
Thailand: New poll shows majority calls for tougher action over behavior of some Israelis

primary_source.title: NIDA Poll finds 77.49% of Thais want law applied strictly to Israelis (NIDA Poll, National Institute of Development Administration, fielded 8-10 Sept 2026, n=1,410; corroborated by Bangkok Post, Khaosod English, Asia News Network, The Thaiger)
